statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code Z86.73 was submitted
The diagnosis code G45.9 was submitted
The diagnosis code I47.1 was submitted
CPT code 93247 long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to capture any underlying rhythm disturbances
The service is clinically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may be contributing to the patient's symptoms and prior cerebrovascular events
